changes_from_v1: split-group authority is wired into build_supervision_window (coordinator gap 3 / review F6): the caller split must equal the group of the episode's ORIGINAL source resolved through configs/split-table.json (versioned, loaded via load_split_table); unknown sources raise instead of receiving an invented assignment; SupervisionSample carries source_family and split_group_id
dead second branch in scan_input_leak removed (review F7); the single tick<=cutoff check remains the per-record control

lossless archive (coordinator gap 4 / review F1): every source stream is archived verbatim into archive.* families with a per-stream mapping/residual inventory in the import manifest; removal edges carry removal evidence instead of asserting from_value as current truth (review F2)

supervision_windows.note: cutoff 250 is the fixed TRAIN cutoff of the prior v2 engineering cohort for this episode; targets are the 11 subsequent capture-step frames
one-step horizon: 5 ticks = 0.5 s physical time

fit_policy.fit_input_rule: tick <= cutoff records of TRAIN episodes only; VALID/TEST fit raises NormalizationScopeError
fit_policy.max_fit_tick_reporting: scaler.scope_document() records the largest tick that entered the fit

leak_audit.future_truth: p01v4.data.windows.reject_future_truth_inputs rejects truth records with tick > cutoff AND input records whose provenance available_time.tick > cutoff
leak_audit.future_visibility_topology: p01v4.data.windows.audit_input_selector perturbs all future field content and requires selector membership to be unchanged; a flip is a future-visibility/topology leak and raises
leak_audit.split_authority: build_supervision_window resolves the episode's ORIGINAL source through configs/split-table.json and refuses caller splits that disagree (v2)

split_group_policy.rule: source_family and split_group derive from the ORIGINAL scenario/seed key <scenario>_v<N>__seed<M>; every old/new copy, 36overlay and normal/congested branch, and every supervision window built from one source shares exactly that original's single split group; versions are not independent examples
split_group_policy.table_source: configs/split-table.json (version 2; TRAIN/VALID assignment transcribed from the prior v2 engineering cohort host_data_v2/cohort.json, cross-checked episode-by-episode in tests/unit/test_split_provenance.py); build_supervision_window enforces it through resolve_source_split
split_group_policy.decorated_ids: variant marks after '::' or '++' are preserved verbatim and never create a new split group; TEST originals are not present in the old cohort and are not invented here
split_group_policy.unknown: any episode id outside the declared table raises SplitGroupError instead of guessing

six_point_supplement_policy.revisions: v14 PACKAGE source_revision is separate from per-dimension producer_revision; a 36x8 package label never proves all eight producers changed; per-dimension actual source files mapped in p01v4.data.provenance.package_revision_document (unprovided dimensions stay producer_revision=null)
six_point_supplement_policy.views: lossless archive view lives in archive.* families of the canonical records (address/archive-only by construction); model_visible_view and model_visible_typed_view admit only tick <= cutoff content and strip archive/terminal/hindsight-only material; known-plan experiments need separate labels
six_point_supplement_policy.transported_q: ORACLE_ONLY (TRUE future + TRAIN-frozen Gaussian noise), never a prediction input
six_point_supplement_policy.splits: ORIGINAL scenario+seed decides; all versions/overlays/load branches/windows share one split; new-scenario generalization claims require the ENTIRE scenario with all seeds held out
six_point_supplement_policy.lp_definitions: legacy q-based L/P (L/p01-legacy-q-bounded-observation) and native mature accepted-cohort TTL L/P (L/p01-ttl-observation-actual-available-time) are different definitions, never one metric under two cohorts; a case without a timely RX has L UNDEFINED (excluded and counted, never folded into the mean as zero)
